newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end up marginally on late buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end up marginally on late buying.

text.p: Sluggish Thai stocks managed to close with a small advance after being trapped in the negative territory almost all day, brokers said.
The SET index, buckling a three-day losing streak, ended up 2.76 points at 790.23 on 3.6 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index advanced 0.41 point to 58.14.
"Investors bought some large capitalised issues in a last minute bargain hunting. The index rose on a technical rebound," said Thanawat Patchimkul of Seamico Securities.
Brokers said the market was sluggish because of sustained worries about weak Thai economic indicators.
"Investors also do not expect improvement in poor fourth quarter earnings of finance and brokerage companies," he said.
Bangkok Bank topped the active list, gaining one baht to 187, Siam Cement fell to 16 to 748, PTT Exploration and Production advanced 12 to 382, and United Communication rose three to 163.
